definition_en: an office or department that deals with public business
core_image: 办事窗口后排着一列文件柜
scene: 大厅里人们拿着表格排队。The travel bureau opens at nine.
sceneCN: 这里 bureau 是「局，处」（第 1 个义项：办理公共事务的机构）；句意是旅行社办事处九点开门。

derivatives.zh: 官僚机构；繁复的行政程序

senses.title: An office for public business
senses.definition: an office or department that handles public affairs
senses.definitionCN: 处理公共事务的办公机构
senses.example: The travel bureau opens at nine.
senses.exampleCN: 旅行社办事处九点开门。
senses.why: The desk where papers were handled gave its name to the office.
senses.whyCN: 处理文件的桌子，把名字让给了整个机构。

senses.title: A writing desk
senses.definition: a desk with drawers for writing
senses.definitionCN: 带抽屉、用来写字的桌子
senses.example: The letters lay open on the bureau.
senses.why: This is the oldest sense, from a cloth covering a desk.
senses.whyCN: 这是最古老的义项，来自铺在桌上的布。

senses.title: A chest of drawers
senses.definition: a piece of furniture with drawers for clothes
senses.definitionCN: 带抽屉、用来放衣物的家具
senses.example: She folded the shirts into the bureau.
senses.exampleCN: 她把衬衫叠好放进五斗柜。
senses.why: American usage moved the desk's drawers into a separate chest.
senses.whyCN: 美式用法把桌子的抽屉独立成了一件柜子。

intro.en: Bureau came from French for a cloth on a desk, then the desk, then the office.
intro.cn: bureau 源自法语「桌上的布」，再由桌子指办公室。

items.en: burel named a coarse woollen cloth.
bureau named the cloth spread on a desk.
bureau meant the desk itself, with drawers.
items.cn: bureau 指带抽屉的写字桌本身。

items.en: The word extended to the office where the desk stood.
items.cn: 这个词扩展到放置办公桌的机构。

items.en: bureau means an agency, a desk or a chest of drawers.
items.cn: 如今 bureau 指机构、写字桌或五斗柜。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the bur- opening; the near-meaning group gives office and furniture words.
note.cn: 形近组共享 bur- 开头；近义组是机构与家具类的词。

entries.definition: the placing of a body in the ground
a person who breaks into buildings
the part of a stove that makes flame
a room where people work at desks
one part of a large organization
a table for writing or working

normalIntro.en: Bureau slides from a cloth, to a desk, to a whole office.
normalIntro.cn: bureau 从一块桌布，滑到桌子，再到整个机构。

normal.en: A travel bureau sells tickets and tours.
normal.cn: 旅行社卖票也安排行程。

normal.en: A bureaucrat works in a bureau.
A bureau drawer holds shirts and socks.
normal.cn: 五斗柜抽屉放衬衫和袜子。

abstract.en: See a cloth smoothed over a wooden top.
abstract.cn: 想象一块布被抚平在木桌面上。

abstract.en: See a queue holding numbered forms.
abstract.cn: 想象一队人拿着编号表格。

abstract.en: See three drawers pulled half open.

examples.en: The travel bureau opens at nine.
examples.cn: 旅行社办事处九点开门。

examples.en: The letters lay open on the bureau.
She folded the shirts into the bureau.
examples.cn: 她把衬衫叠好放进五斗柜。

dict_mnemonic.text: bureau 结尾的 eau 是法语里常见的写法，看到它就想起这个词是从法语借来的。

root: bureau 借自古法语 burel（粗毛布），十六世纪指铺在桌上的布，十七世纪指带抽屉的写字桌，十八世纪起指摆放此桌的办事机构，美式英语又用它指五斗柜。

sensesIntro.en: An office that handles papers, the desk itself, and a chest of drawers.
sensesIntro.cn: 处理文件的机构、那张桌子本身、以及一只五斗柜。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a service counter with files behind it.
core.cn: 核心意象：柜台后面排着一列文件。

intro.en: Bureau builds -crat and -cracy words about officials and rules.
intro.cn: bureau 可与 -crat、-cracy 构成表示官员与体制的词。

latinIntro.en: The base is French; the Latin items below are related only in meaning.
latinIntro.cn: 词基来自法语，下面的拉丁词只在意思上相关。

items.meaning: a business or office that acts for others
